Issue Title: Skill degradation from over-use of AI
Description: Over-use of AI might lead to a degredation in software skills for RSE professionals. This could have unintended consequences on code quality, research integrity and critical review capabilities.
Mitigations: Ensure software training remains central to RSE development. Ensure relevant skills and experience remain highly valued by employers and institutions. Demonstrate the effectiveness of relevant skills when developing research code with AI.
Tags: Professional, Training and Development, Research Integrity

Description: Overuse of AI can lead to environmental challenges such as energy depletion and water use.
Mitigations: RSEs should aim to reduce reliance on AI and use smaller local models.
